title: Extremal Domain Translation with Neural Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: extremal transport 形式化最保真翻译（映到 Supp(Q) 的最近邻），证明它是 incomplete transport T#P<=wQ 在 w->inf 的极限，并给出 max-min 求解器
tldr_en: Extremal transport formalizes the most input-faithful unpaired translation (nearest neighbors in Supp(Q)); it is the w->inf limit of incomplete transport T#P<=wQ, solved by a scalable max-min algorithm.
key_numbers: handbag->shoes 128px test l2 cost / FID: w=1 0.368/27.10, w=8 0.252/53.80 (Table 1)
